thread:
Nora: hey folks, new hire Nora here. first on-call tonight. two quick setup issues and a process question.
Devon: welcome Nora! keep it short and we'll help.
Nora: 1) my PagerDuty SMS comes through but the PD app never rings. i tried reinstalling.
ops-it: check PD user profile -> contact methods. if you have both sms and mobile app, PD sometimes prefers sms for low-priority tests. also confirm the app has background data allowed on Android.
Nora: 2) i added my phone but the PD web UI shows me as "unverified". how do i verify?
ops-it: you should have gotten a 6-digit code via SMS after adding the number. if not, hit "resend" in the PD contact method page. if the code times out, open a ticket with us.
Nora: ok will try resend.
Nora: process q: when we page, should we always create an incidents channel or only for Sev2+?
Devon: guideline: auto-create for every incident is fine if the service has auto-create enabled. otherwise: Sev3 and below -> a short thread in the service channel. Sev2+ -> create #incidents/<service>-<id> and invite EM + CS lead.
Devon: quick triage bullets for first timers: 1) ack in PD 2) run runbook top steps 3) check deploys 4) collect logs 5) notify EM if >15m. keep initial posts concise.
sre-training: adding: if you want a buddy shadow, tag @sre-training before your shift and we'll attach a shadow flag so the PD notification shows "shadow: yourname".
Nora: cool. i'm going to resend verification and then run a simulated page at 02:00 UTC to test routing. i'll ping here when i run it.
oncall-bot: Tip: Complete the oncall quickstart checklist at https://internal.redwood/oncall-quickstart before taking live pages.
Nora: thanks everyone!
